minutes.headline: Finance Committee voted 5-0 to recommend the FY16 budget and spend the surplus on public safety, library, snow and ice.
minutes.summary: The committee heard public safety and library requests for added money, then reviewed the FY15 budget adjustments and the capital plan. It divided the available surplus among the requests, voted to recommend the FY16 budget, stabilization, capital and sewer articles, and rescission articles.

what_happened.line: The Finance Committee voted 5-0 to recommend the FY16 budget.
It voted 5-0 on an amended split of the available surplus among stabilization, library, fire, police desk, vehicle maintenance, snow and ice, and police lockup.
It voted to recommend the stabilization transfer, the FY16 capital plan, and the sewer enterprise article.
It voted to recommend articles rescinding unused sewer, Turkey Hill heating and Passios heating borrowing authorizations, and an article appropriating a bond premium.
The FY15 budget adjustment article was held for a later meeting and not voted.

why_it_matters: The surplus split decides which public safety, library and road-maintenance requests get funded in FY16 and how much goes to savings, which bears on the tax bill and on services residents use.
The committee's recommendations on these articles will be put to residents at Town Meeting, where voters will be asked to approve or reject each one, including borrowing for the capital plan.
watch_next: Next regular meeting April 23rd, with a possible pre-town-meeting session May 2nd.
The chair's draft committee letter, due to circulate by Sunday, and the held FY15 budget adjustment article.
